body.statement: With observational data and two coupled hard-intervention environments per node whose paired mechanisms satisfy the almost-everywhere interventional-discrepancy condition, the population model identifies the latent variables up to componentwise diffeomorphisms and identifies the latent DAG.

source.verbatim_statement: Using observational data and interventional data from two coupled hard environments for which the pair (q_i, q_tilde_i) satisfies interventional discrepancy for all i in [n], suffice to identify (i) the latent DAG G perfectly and (ii) the latent variables Z up to componentwise diffeomorphisms specified in Theorem 5. Specifically, Algorithm 3 achieves these identifiability guarantees.

attestation.note: Directly verified against the JMLR 2025 publisher PDF, Score-based Causal Representation Learning: Linear and General Transformations, pages 27 and 29-31, Definition 21, Lemma 23, and Theorem 25, accessed 2026-09-11.
